recipes.name: Approval Workflow
recipes.description: Sequential approval chain: manager then admin (configurable). Sends approval notifications, handles approve/deny/return-for-info responses, enforces timeout reminders at halfway marks and escalates on full timeout. High-privilege requests always route through human review regardless of auto-rules. Emergency urgency uses shortened timeouts.

recipes.name: Scan & Enrich Implementation Opportunities
recipes.description: Weekly scan across configured email senders. Extracts URLs, enriches each via web fetch (with web_search fallback), classifies into new_connector / api_version / tooling, computes relevance from topic-preference memory. Cadence is managed at the trigger-composition step; default weekly Saturday 3pm.

If an email connector is also connected, additionally scan configured senders' newsletters/release emails. Enriches each candidate, classifies into new_connector / api_version / tooling, dedups against memory, and produces candidates for human triage. Always delivers from web research even with no inbox. EMAIL SCAN (when relevant): the user's Gmail is reachable directly via the MCP tools `mcp__personas__gmail_list_messages` (args: {query, max_results} — e.g. query 'newer_than:7d category:promotions OR from:noreply' for vendor/release mail) and `mcp__personas__gmail_get_message` (args: {message_id, format:'metadata'|'full'}) — these read the connected Gmail through the vault credential with NO interactive auth and NO API key. recipes.description: Presents each discovered candidate to the human for accept/reject. Accepted items emit to downstream implementation agents; rejected items capture a reason and train topic preferences. Event-chained on `scout.opportunity.discovered`.

recipes.name: Detect and Post
recipes.description: Query the analytics tool for the latest window, compare against EWMA baselines, classify deviations by severity, and post insight cards via Messages. Tracks signal persistence and recovery across runs. Cadence is managed at the trigger-composition step; default daily 9am with optional mid-day recheck.

recipes.name: Ticket Critical Signals

recipes.name: Event Routing & Anomaly Detection

Event-driven; not configurable at the trigger-composition step.
